policy: Tasks are intentionally explicit, bounded, dependency-free, and externally graded. The driver materializes initialFiles but withholds graderAssertions from the agent workspace.

tasks.prompt: Add and export a clamp(value, min, max) function in src/clamp.js. Throw RangeError when min is greater than max. Do not add dependencies or change other files.

Implement the existing slugify(input: string): string stub in src/slugify.ts. Lowercase ASCII text, trim surrounding whitespace, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and remove leading or trailing hyphens. Change only that file.

Implement normalize_whitespace(value: str) in text_utils.py so every Unicode whitespace run becomes one ASCII space and leading or trailing whitespace is removed. Preserve non-whitespace characters. Use only the standard library.

tasks.prompt: Implement DedupeStable in dedupe.go. Return a new []string containing the first occurrence of each value in input order. Do not mutate the input. A nil input must return nil. Use only the standard library.

Implement and export parsePort(value) in src/port.js. Accept a decimal string with optional surrounding whitespace and return an integer from 1 through 65535. Throw TypeError for non-strings and RangeError for every invalid string or out-of-range value. Do not add dependencies.

Implement chunks(items, size) in chunks.py. Return a list of lists in input order, with the final chunk possibly shorter. Raise ValueError when size is not a positive integer, including bool. Do not mutate items and use only the standard library.
